column3: Honda targets Level 4 autonomy by 2027, AI maps by 2030
column4: Honda Motor plans to achieve Level 4 autonomous driving around 2027 and replace high-definition maps with AI technology around 2030, enabling Level 4 vehicles to navigate the narrow roads and mountain routes common in Asia, said Yuji Yasui, a fellow at Honda R&D, at Hon Hai Tech Day 2026 (HHTD26).

column3: Micron says 700-plus Taiwan fab workers earned five years' salary in a single year
column4: Micron Technology paid its fiscal 2026 bonuses to Taiwan employees on October 30. The company said more than 700 production-line workers earned at least five years' worth of monthly salary in total pay for the year. The payout comes while the union at its Taoyuan fab is still rejecting the company's pay offer.

column3: Realtek targets 30% AI revenue share by 2030
column4: Realtek Semiconductor quantified its AI business for the first time at an investor conference on October 29, setting a target for high-performance computing (HPC) and edge AI revenue—including automotive and robotics applications—to exceed 30% of total revenue by 2030.
